transcription_method: Manual visual transcription of the chart labels and bar counts. The PDF page was rendered at 125 dpi for inspection. Counts were not generated by OCR or statistical estimation.
interpretation: The chart presents bins of reported format-level average cycle values. It does not identify individual assets, cohort entry counts, censoring, retirement, or an asset survival distribution. The entity represented by each plotted count is not fully documented, so the five crate entries must not be treated as five asset cohorts.
redistribution: The source report is not copied into the derived file; refer to the public source URL and its terms.
